import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Click on the 'Issues 78' link to navigate to the issues list page
    issues_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Issues 78", exact=False)
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Try to find and apply label filter for 'flaky-test'
    label_filter = page.get_by_role("button", name="Labels", exact=False)
    if await label_filter.count() > 0:
        await label_filter.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        label_search = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search labels", exact=False)
        if await label_search.count() > 0:
            await label_search.fill("flaky-test")
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            flaky_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="flaky-test", exact=False)
            if await flaky_option.count() > 0:
                await flaky_option.click()
                await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
                await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Retrieve and display the list of issues
    issues_list = []
    # Look for issue links in the main content
    issue_links = page.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text="keycloak/keycloak")
    count = await issue_links.count()
    for i in range(count):
        link = issue_links.nth(i)
        text = await link.text_content()
        issues_list.append(text)
    
    # If no issue links found, try to get any list items or articles
    if not issues_list:
        container = page.get_by_role("list")
        if await container.count() == 0:
            container = page.get_by_role("grid")
        if await container.count() > 0:
            items = container.get_by_role("listitem")
            if await items.count() == 0:
                items = container.get_by_role("row")
            item_count = await items.count()
            for i in range(item_count):
                item = items.nth(i)
                text = await item.text_content()
                issues_list.append(text)
        else:
            articles = page.get_by_role("article")
            article_count = await articles.count()
            for i in range(article_count):
                article = articles.nth(i)
                text = await article.text_content()
                issues_list.append(text)
    
    # Print each issue text
    for issue in issues_list:
        print(issue)
